name: Feature::Ui
guard: The game's file-resource lookup `(u32* out_handle, u64 hash40)`: writes the resource handle of a file path hash (0xffffff when the file is not in the resource table) and takes one reference on it. The same call the game's UI asset loader makes for a stage or fighter UI texture, so a mod's replacement file is what loads. Its words 10 and 11 (`adrp x9, 0x5332000; ldr x20, [x9, #0xf20]`) name the file-resource service's global slot (`main+0x5332f20`), which the plugin decodes from them (`UI_TEX_SERVICE_SLOT_WORDS_OFFSET`).

name: Feature::Ui
guard: The game's UI texture constructor `(shared_ptr_out[2], const u32* handle)`: allocates the 0x68-byte UI texture, takes its own reference on the handle and queues the file for loading. Writes the shared pointer (a 0x10-byte holder whose +8 is the UI texture, and its control block) to the first argument.

name: Feature::Ui
guard: The game's UI texture update `(ui_texture*)`: once the file is loaded it copies the BNTX, builds the GPU memory pool, texture and view and registers the view's descriptor slot (the code the game's own bind runs before it reads the texture).
